message: Dependabot proposes composer updates after 1 day (default-days: 1 in .github/dependabot.yml), but Composer waits 3 days (config.policy.cooldown.period: "3 days" in composer.json); its pull requests bring in versions younger than Composer accepts, or fail where the lockfile is re-checked
fix: Make the Dependabot delay at least 3 days, or run depcurfew apply

message: Dependabot counts the cooldown of composer updates from time, the release time the package author writes, not from published-time, when Packagist received the version, and it updates composer.lock with Composer 2.10.3, which has no cooldown; a version published with an older time is proposed at once, and composer install takes it from composer.lock without Composer's cooldown
fix: Check the publication date on Packagist before merging Dependabot's composer pull requests, or update Composer packages with a bot that counts from published-time
